text: Можна залишитися ще на одну ніч?
romanization_bgn: Mozhna zalyshytysia shche na odnu nich?
ipa: mˈoʒna zalɪʃˈɪtɪsja ʃtʃˈɛ nˈa ˈodnu ɲˈiːtʃ

literal: stop, nothing further is needed -- the second clause is what makes it terminal, exactly as in the Mandarin row, because a bare Зупиніться would be heard as the pause below it. A plain imperative, unsoftened, against this pack's usual Можна ...? requests

make a pause, please -- пауза says temporarily on its own, and unlike this pack's communication.please-wait-a-moment (Зачекайте, будь ласка) it asks the listener to suspend what they are doing rather than to wait for the speaker

text: Не натискайте на цю ділянку, будь ласка.
romanization_bgn: Ne natyskaite na tsiu dilianku, bud laska.
ipa: nˈɛ natˈɪskajtɛ nˈa tsjˈu diːʎˈanku, bˈud lˈaska
literal: please do not press on this area -- ділянка is the word Ukrainian massage writing uses for a worked region of the body (ділянка шийного відділу, ділянка попереку), and натискання is one of its named strokes

press harder, please -- натискати keeps it about pressure rather than speed. Four words against the one of М'якше, because neither button carries a labelKey on the spa board and the owner's own wording is what labels them, side by side
softer -- the low end of the трохи м'який / помірний / інтенсивний тиск scale the same source uses. Left bare so its shape differs from the row beside it

text: Ось так добре, так і продовжуйте.
romanization_bgn: Os tak dobre, tak i prodovzhuite.
ipa: ˈos tˈaɡ dˈobrɛ, tˈak ˈiː prodˈoʋʒujtɛ
literal: just like that is good, carry on like that -- a confirmation with a keep-it-there clause, not praise. тиск is deliberately not used: in Ukrainian it is read first as blood pressure, so the row names the action rather than the noun
please work on the shoulders -- працювати з зоною is the phrasing the same source uses for spending the time on one region

the trade groups this with the shoulders and the upper back as the шийно-комірцева зона -- Kyiv clinics sell Масаж шийно-комірцевої зони as one bookable service covering шия, плечі and the upper back, but the two rows stay separate because a board button is one meaning
стопа rather than this pack's body-parts.foot ступня, because масаж стоп is the trade's own name for foot massage as a bookable service
all right, I am leaving this area alone -- 1sg non-past, which does not inflect for the speaker's gender, where a past tense derived from a participle would

text: У цій процедурі без цієї ділянки не обійтися.
romanization_bgn: U tsii protseduri bez tsiiei dilianky ne obiitysia.
ipa: ˈu tsˈiːj protsɪdˈuriː bˈɛs tsiːjˈɛjiː diːʎˈankɪ nˈɛ obˈiːjtɪsja
literal: in this procedure there is no doing without this area -- an impersonal infinitive, so neither speaker nor listener is gendered; процедура is one bookable service, not a курс, which would be a course of several and overstate what is being refused

text: Я не знаю, треба запитати в адміністратора.
romanization_bgn: Ya ne znaiu, treba zapytaty v administratora.
ipa: jˈa nˈɛ znˈaju, trˈɛba zapˈɪtatɪ ʋ admiːɲˈiːstratora
literal: I do not know, I have to ask the administrator -- не знаю is 1sg non-past and treba is impersonal, so the speaker is not gendered; адміністратор, the salon's shift supervisor, is an epicene -тор title with no feminine form in the official register, so the person named is not gendered either
